text: Male, adult. Lean build. Pale gray skin. Long white hair, straight, shoulder-length. Oval face with sharp jawline. Prominent brow ridge. Dark purple robe with black belt, dark blue pants, black boots. Standing front-facing, arms at sides. Hair falls past shoulders. Robe has wide sleeves and high collar. Black cuffs. Belt buckle visible. Eyes narrowed. Lips thin. Earlobe piercing with hoop earring.
